roomMode.description: The VIP's lobby switch "Where is everyone?"; fixed once a game starts. Combines with phone-only.

manifestPresence.description: Manifest field. needs: anywhere (🌐, no notice) · voice-if-remote (🎧, notice when the room is remote-text) · same-room (📍, notice when any player cannot see the TV).

note.description: One translatable sentence for the notice.

gameContext.description: What init receives, fixed at start and part of the seeded inputs (determinism): ctx.presence plus player.canSeeTv on every player. Fallback if the context type cannot change: a reserved read-only setting `__presence` of this shape.

canSeeTv.description: playerId → the phone's "I can see the TV" toggle at start. Default on unless the phone's address is outside 10.x / 172.16–31.x / 192.168.x (Tailscale 100.x counts as outside).
